newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: European Leisure buys four snooker clubs.
newsitem.headline: European Leisure buys four snooker clubs.

text.p: European Leisure said on Friday that it had acquired four snooker clubs from Stanley Leisure Plc for a cash consideration of 725,000 sterling.

The clubs, located in the northwest of England, bring the total number of clubs in the company's Rileys Sports Bar and Leisure division to 62 from 53 at end-1996, European Leisure said in a statement.
European Leisure said it has also acquired five other clubs since January 1, 1997.
"After conversion of our Rileys format and with our expertise in this sector, we are very hopeful that this will prove a highly successful investment," chief executive Ian Rock said.
"We are running ahead of our original plans for rolling out Rileys American pool and snooker concept and have several other properties and businesses under negotiation," he said.
Stanley Leisure said it was disposing of the clubs because the industry has been through difficult trading conditions and it was not able to develop the division.
"As a consequence, the board of Stanley Leisure decided that it was not in the long-term interests of the group to progress the business further."
